topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I step into the dim light of the café, the bell above the door barely chiming. Another day, another case. This one starts off with a time capsule. A time capsule they didn't bury. Figures. Some folks can't even keep track of their own history, yet they're surprised when it comes back to knock on their door. I take a sip of coffee, black as the night and twice as bitter. They want to know what’s inside? Fine. But I’ve learned one thing over the years: when the past catches up, it’s never just to say hello. I’ll dig, sure, but I won’t like it. And they sure won’t like what they find.
